## Coherent Beats Q4 Estimates; Analyst Questions Whether Stock Remains Undervalued

A Q4 beat from Coherent reinforces the optical interconnect demand story tied to AI data center bandwidth upgrades; if the market has not fully priced the AI-driven volume ramp in high-speed optics, COHR could represent a lagged beneficiary worth revisiting on position sizing within the AI infrastructure complex.

- Coherent beat fourth-quarter earnings estimates.
- A single analyst piece raises the question of whether the stock may still be undervalued following the beat, citing an approximate figure from the headline.
- The beat is consistent with the AI-driven optical interconnect demand thesis at hyperscalers.
- The undervaluation argument is analyst opinion from one outlet and should not be treated as consensus.
